name: wclip
description: Clip web articles to Markdown notes with YAML frontmatter (Defuddle-based).

scripts.build:bin: tsc && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 --external 'chromium-bidi/*' src/cli.ts --outfile build/wclip-linux-x64 && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64-baseline --external 'chromium-bidi/*' src/cli.ts --outfile build/wclip-linux-x64-baseline && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-arm64 --external 'chromium-bidi/*' src/cli.ts --outfile build/wclip-linux-arm64
scripts.build:js: tsc && bun build --target=node --minify --external 'chromium-bidi/*' src/cli.ts --outfile build/wclip-node.js && bun build --target=bun --minify --external 'chromium-bidi/*' src/cli.ts --outfile build/wclip-bun.js && sed -i '1s|^#!/usr/bin/env node|#!/usr/bin/env bun|' build/wclip-bun.js
